name: Arnav Bule
role: AI/ML developer based in Pune, India.
intro: I build practical AI systems and interactive web experiences.
Local models, visual infrastructure, and the occasional idea that grows into a tree.
tagline: Ideas into systems. Systems into something useful.
focus: Local AI / full-stack tools / creative interfaces

featured.name: Cadence
featured.summary: An evaluated AI support agent for @SpotifyCares: classifies a tweet, drafts a grounded reply of at most 280 characters and decides whether to escalate. 0.938 escalation recall on a frozen holdout.

featured.name: Parakh
featured.summary: A serverless AI exam checker. Upload a question paper and a handwritten answer sheet; every answer is located and highlighted on the page, graded, and given written feedback.

featured.name: Sentinel
featured.summary: Video anomaly detection that runs entirely on one 8 GB laptop GPU. Placed #1 on the AHC Visual Intelligence Hackathon live leaderboard with 67.8 points.

featured.name: QR Studio
featured.summary: A WebGPU studio that grows any link into a 3D voxel tree whose canopy encodes a working QR code, captured off the GPU canvas as a PNG that phone cameras can scan.

featured.name: Sicklesense
featured.summary: Detects sickle cells in blood smear images with a fine-tuned ResNet50, achieving >92% accuracy. Third place at the University of Miami Horizon AI Hackathon 2025.

featured.name: Mini Task Tracker
featured.summary: A full-stack task tracker: email-OTP auth, JWT sessions, Redis-cached listings and a drag-and-drop Kanban board whose ordering is persisted in MongoDB.

featured.name: Email Digital Twin
featured.summary: A Chrome extension and Node.js backend that learns a writing style from sent mail and drafts replies with Google Gemini and LanceDB retrieval.

projects.title: Sentinel
projects.subtitle: Local AI, with evidence
projects.description: A local video anomaly detection pipeline combining CLIP, Qwen3-VL and temporal evidence. The review dashboard puts detections, event timelines and supporting evidence in one place.
projects.alt: Sentinel review dashboard showing video anomaly results, evidence and timeline.

projects.title: Zenith.ai
projects.subtitle: Infrastructure, in view
projects.description: A visual workspace for mapping systems, reviewing deployment plans and exporting Terraform. Make the relationships in a stack easier to see and reason about.
projects.alt: Zenith system map showing connected infrastructure resources and a resource inspector.
projects.note: Sandbox operations are simulated; the AWS workflow provides plans and exports.

projects.title: QR Tree Studio
projects.subtitle: A QR code that grows
projects.description: Turn a URL into a scannable voxel tree. Explore seasonal themes, tune the palette and switch to a top-down QR view in an interactive 3D canvas.
projects.alt: QR Tree Studio showing a summer voxel tree, URL input and seasonal controls.
projects.note: Built with the open-source magic-tree-qr rendering engine.
